What Sharpwise covers

Sharpwise has 343 maths and English topics, from Reception to Year 6. Each one is listed below under its school year, with the part of the curriculum it practises.

Reception topics follow the EYFS Early Learning Goals. Years 1 to 6 follow the National Curriculum for England. This page is made from the game's own list of topics, so it changes when the game does.

72 of the 78 parts of the curriculum we track have at least one topic. Each year ends with the parts that are not covered yet.
